issues.description: setuptools<82 added as runtime dependency in core/setup.py affects all users, not just CI
issues.detail: The cap was added to install_requires in core/setup.py, which propagates to every downstream user installing autogluon.core. The CI failure is build-time only; pinning a runtime ceiling on setuptools forces all users into stale tooling. Move this constraint to the CI scripts or scope it to the raytune extra with a clearer comment and FIXME link.

issues.description: mmdet bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 without justification in PR body
issues.detail: The diff changes mmdet from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 alongside the mmengine workaround. This is a behavior/version change unrelated to the stated setuptools fix and isn't mentioned in the description. If 3.3.0 is required for compatibility with mmengine 0.10.7, document why; otherwise keep 3.2.0 to minimize blast radius.

issues.description: Installing mmcv with --no-build-isolation requires build deps preinstalled
issues.detail: Switching from `mim install` to `pip install --no-build-isolation` means pip will not create an isolated build env, so torch, ninja, and any other build-time requirements of mmcv 2.1.0 must already exist in the environment. If the calling workflow does not guarantee torch is installed before setup_mmcv runs, the wheel build will fail with cryptic errors.

issues.description: Order of pip installs may still let setuptools get upgraded by a later transitive resolve
issues.detail: setuptools<82 is pinned, then mmcv is built, then mmengine and mmdet are installed. If a subsequent package's requirements pull a newer setuptools, the pin won't hold (it's a one-shot install, not a constraint file). Consider a constraints file or repeating the pin to be safe across the script's lifetime.

issues.description: FIXME comments lack owner and revisit trigger
issues.detail: Both FIXME comments reference mmcv issue #3325 but no owner is assigned and no condition for removal beyond 'once fixed'. Consider adding a TODO with an explicit removal checklist (e.g., 'remove when mmcv >=2.2 released') so this temporary pin doesn't become permanent technical debt.

review.summary: The PR works around an mmcv/setuptools incompatibility by pinning setuptools<82 in three places and switching mmcv install off of mim. The main concern is leaking a CI-only workaround into core/setup.py's install_requires, which forces all downstream autogluon.core users onto an old setuptools. Secondary concerns: undocumented mmdet 3.2.0→3.3.0 bump, --no-build-isolation requiring preinstalled build deps, and FIXMEs without clear removal triggers.
